request.subject: ICON:ACTION:SWALLOW

layers.text: Redraw it as a different object in the same style: one huge wide-open gaping mouth of pale blue-grey stitched flesh seen from the front, crooked ivory teeth and a long tongue, with one small round wooden shield and a short sword tumbling down into it. Nothing else: no bone, no eyes, no face. Thick dark outline, flat colours, on a transparent background.
